transfer-between-own-accounts: Transferred $500 from savings to checking. Your savings balance is now $3,000 and your checking balance is $1,750.
transfer-and-close-savings: Transferred your full savings balance of $3,500 to checking and closed your savings account. Your checking balance is now $4,750 and your closed savings account has a zero balance.
close-savings: Your savings account still has $3,500. Where would you like that money moved before I close the account? I have left your account open and made no changes.
transfer-over-balance: I cannot transfer $4,000 because your savings account only has $3,500. No transfer was made; your savings balance remains $3,500 and your checking balance remains $1,250.
